faq.q: Does this show current flood conditions?
faq.a: No. This story uses fictional illustrative geography alongside a historical planning demonstration.

faq.q: Is the animation a flood forecast?
faq.a: No. The three water states explain the story; they are not a forecast or a measured flood-time sequence.

faq.q: Does the example report send a rescue request?
faq.a: No. The sample observation and review brief are local illustrations. They do not submit a report or dispatch help.
